standard_prerequisites.name: Local duality for two-term complexes of tori over a local field
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a local field complete for a discrete valuation with finite residue field, a two-term complex of tori has perfect local pairings, and the unramified subgroups are mutual annihilators.
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Demarche, Theoremes de dualite pour les complexes de tores, Theorems 3.1 and 3.3; scope note sources/jep-2020-129-tori-duality/local-duality-prerequisite-note.md; cited by the author at source line 1986.
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the isomorphism of the ramified vertical map in the counted diagram chase. No global duality result is assumed.

standard_prerequisites.name: Classical arithmetic inputs cited inside the retained proofs
standard_prerequisites.statement: Brauer-Hasse-Noether, Hilbert 90, Lang's theorem for tori over finite fields, finiteness of the Brauer group of a finite field, the ideal class group and unit theorem of a global function field, Milne's arithmetic duality theorems III.8.9, II.2.9, II.2.10 and II.3.1, and the local topology of Cesnavicius.
standard_prerequisites.use: Used only inside the retained lemmas and their proofs (bhn, h1lem, fini1, fini2, closedimage, injectcompl, vanishlocal), which are included with their author proofs.

standard_prerequisites.name: Homological and topological algebra
standard_prerequisites.statement: The five lemma and the snake lemma, exactness of inverse limits of surjective systems, l-adic and profinite completions, Pontryagin duality for discrete torsion groups, and profinite groups.
standard_prerequisites.use: The formal mechanism of the completion lemma and of the counted diagram chase.

core_obligations: Define the D-groups D^i(U,F) as the image of compact-support cohomology inside ordinary cohomology, equivalently as the kernel of the localisation map to the direct sum of the local groups, and record the exact sequences that use them.

Prove the finiteness and finite-type statements needed here: H^i(U, dual T) of finite type for i = -1, 0 together with the injectivity of H^1(U, dual C) into H^1(K, dual C), the finiteness of H^2_c(U,T) and, for U different from X, of H^2_c(U, dual T); deduce the finiteness of D^1(U,C) and of D^1(U, dual C).

Prove the completion lemma: for a short exact sequence of abelian groups with finite l-torsion in the last term, the sequence of l-adic completions remains exact, and apply it to the localisation sequence to obtain the exact sequence of profinite completions used in the counted diagram.

Prove the global compact-support duality for a two-term complex of tori (pairing of H^1(U,C) with the completion of H^1_c(U, dual C), and of H^2(U,C) with the completion of H^0_c(U, dual C)) by reducing both to the length-one case through a five-lemma argument.

Prove that the maps induced by the pairings are surjective with divisible kernel, then assemble the two exact rows of the counted diagram, use the local duality theorem and the global compact-support duality for the two middle isomorphisms, and conclude that for every prime l the group D^1(U,C){l} is dual to the l-adic completion of D^1(U, dual C), whence the perfect pairing of finite groups.

difficulty_reason: The counted statement is that the pairing induced by the compactly supported cup product for r = 1 is a perfect pairing of finite groups between D^1(U,C) and D^1(U, dual of C), where D^i(U,F) is the kernel of the localisation map from H^i(U,F) to the direct sum of the local groups (definition at source lines 641-648) and C is a two-term complex of U-tori over a curve over a finite field (source lines 1943-1949). Its proof is a diagram chase between two exact rows (source lines 1953-1961) whose ramified vertical map is an isomorphism by the local duality theorem and whose middle vertical map is an isomorphism by the global compact-support duality for the complex (source lines 1986-1990). The non-formal step is the exactness of the sequence of l-adic completions of the localisation sequence: the completion functor is not right exact in general, so the author has to invoke the completion lemma at source lines 1969-1978 together with the finiteness of the D-groups at source lines 1991-1994.

compared.statement: Integral compact-support character duality for two-term torus complexes on curves over finite fields, including primary characteristic torsion (source Theorem refin2, lines 1760-1781).
compared.difference: That item pairs cohomology groups of the complex itself with completions of compact-support groups of the dual complex; the counted statement here pairs the finite D-groups of the complex and of its dual at the first level, and it also uses that theorem as a retained ingredient rather than restating it.

compared.statement: Poitou-Tate I for two-term torus complexes over a positive-characteristic global field (source Theorem spt1, lines 2515-2537; published task A-1933-poitou-tate-I).
compared.difference: A global nine-term exact sequence with restricted products and the groups Sha; the counted statement here is a two-group perfect pairing on one open curve with no restricted product, and it is used inside the proof of that global sequence rather than following from it.
